proves.claim: a system-actor withdraw citing a main commit that carries the work is written as met and the withdrawn record names the commit.

store.io-board-withdraw.system-actor-as-.why: Without this test, a system-actor withdraw as met would leave no record of the commit that met it, or the store would never admit it.

proves.claim: a seat withdraw and a system-actor withdraw citing no commit or a commit that does not carry the work are refused and write nothing.

store.io-board-withdraw.refuses-uncited-.why: Without this test, a withdraw as met could be written with no commit, or one that is not on main, and close an item whose work never landed.
